description: This file defines client-side functions for interacting with an ingestion API backend. It includes methods for fetching plain-text error messages, ingestion results, and a fetch wrapper that handles both GET and POST requests, tailored for the ingestion process within a React-based frontend project.

methods.name: apiFetchText(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, baseUrl, allowRelative = false } = {})
methods.description: Fetches plain-text responses from the backend, handling URL normalization, request setup, and error handling, distinguishing from JSON fetches.

methods.name: fetchDateTimeMissingErrorMessage()
methods.description: Fetches a plain-text error message about missing date/time from the backend ingestion API.

methods.name: fetchIngestionResult({ payload } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves the ingestion result from the backend, with fallback logic for GET and POST requests.
